items.description: Local Weather is a web application that automatically show users their local weather forecast. This application uses ipinfo.io API and OpenWeatherMap API.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.

Get to know any British Member of Parliament. Select by location, postcode or name. Traversing the UK map provides a constituency grid and instant feedback of its local MP. Extra information provides anecdotal quotes and wiki entries for the local area.
Calculates slope angle and aspect from USGS and Google elevation api's. This information is used by backcountry skiers, split boarders, and snow mobile riders for avalanche safety.
Hoiio Wave is a device to keep drivers safe on the road. By measuring the brain wave, it detects a driver's attention level, and uses the Hoiio APIs to alert him in different ways.

Sush.io is a web application that allows businesses to connect all of their applications together. Sush.io focuses on automation, from automatically adding new contacts to invoicing clients. Sush.io saves businesses time by eliminating repetitive tasks.
Workouts is a flex based application that uses the del.icio.us API to find workouts related to user selected muscle groups.
Generates a feed of new and upcoming music releases from the artists you scrobble on Last.fm.

Open Source Tracking and Analytics Software for online marketers. Enables users to track the keywords and placements generating calls to your call center. Using the new Twilio Client, we can now track exactly which keywords and channels are converting into calls and help you optimize your ad spend.
Kids today won't know the shrill cry of a 9600 baud or the magical doodleeedoo of a 28.8 modem. Preserve a little slice of history by recording and publishing your best dialup modem impression.
This nice graphing application shows you the count of del.icio.us tags applied to a given URL over time. By Terrell Russell.
Shows exponentially smoothed flu trends in Sweden based on self-reported health in Twitter messages.
HomeWebShop.com is an online shopping site that combines Google Maps and Amazon.com shopping services.

Find Tesco store locations on a Virtual Earth map of the UK with an optional satellite image overlay. Hover the mouse over a location to get directions, or click on the name of the store to view its address, phone number and store hours.
Halifax, Nova Scotia, map of attractions.
Around! is an iPhone app built around the idea of location-based deals. Allows users to unlock special privileges at participating outlets in Singapore.
World box office movie search aggregates movie reviews, enabling users to find great movies to watch.
